set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- API does not imply low-rank solve scaling unless factorized end-to-end.
- Either implement genuine factorized GW or rename/deprecate post-hoc SVD.
- Compatibility parameters are implemented, removed, or rejected.
- Peak-memory evidence supports any scaling claim.
- Migration and lifecycle status are documented.
set.title: Replace, rename, or deprecate the pseudo-low-rank GW interface
